description: This file defines the XTemplate class for HTML template rendering, including methods for variable assignment, block parsing, and file inclusion, used within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: A class for managing HTML templates with support for blocks, variables, and nested templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that loads and preprocesses a template file.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the template.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to a variable array.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a block within the template, replacing variables.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a block has been parsed or exists.

methods.name: var_exists
methods.description: Checks if a variable exists within a block.

methods.name: rparse
methods.description: Recursively parses a block and its sub-blocks.

methods.name: insert_loop
methods.description: Inserts a loop by assigning a variable and parsing a block.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the parsed text of a block.

methods.name: out
methods.description: Outputs the parsed block, with access control.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parsed content of a block.

methods.name: parsed
methods.description: Checks if a block has been parsed.

methods.name: SetNullString
methods.description: Sets the default string for unassigned variables.

methods.name: SetNullBlock
methods.description: Sets the default string for unparsed blocks.

methods.name: set_autoreset
methods.description: Enables automatic resetting of sub-blocks after parsing.

methods.name: clear_autoreset
methods.description: Disables automatic resetting of sub-blocks.

methods.name: scan_globals
methods.description: Loads global variables into the template.

methods.name: maketree
methods.description: Builds the block hierarchy from template content.

methods.name: get_error
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets an error message.

methods.name: getfile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file.

methods.name: r_getfile
methods.description: Recursively loads files referenced within a template.
